header.eyebrow: We Would Love to Meet You
header.heading: Contact & Visit
header.lede: Questions about the parish, sacraments, or joining our community? Reach out — the parish office is happy to help.

clergy.heading: Clergy
clergy.sacraments: For baptisms, weddings, confessions, anointing of the sick, or to arrange a home or hospital visit, please contact the parish office.
clergy.newHere: Welcome! Introduce yourself after any Liturgy.

finding.heading: Finding Us
finding.text: We are located at 10th and Ellsworth Streets in the Bella Vista neighborhood of South Philadelphia, a short walk from the Italian Market. Street parking is available nearby.
finding.mapAddress: Saint Maron Maronite Catholic Church, 1013 Ellsworth St, Philadelphia, PA 19147
